// ADR-284 §7a acceptance set — emoji-picker rebuilt in the builder, generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr284CodeView.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {useFilter} from 'react-aria';
import {ListBox, ListBoxItem} from 'react-aria-components';
import emojis from './data/emojis';

export default function Home() {
  let {startsWith: startsWithVariant} = useFilter({sensitivity: 'variant'});
  let emojisView = emojis
    .filter(item =>
      (item.label != null && item.label !== '') &&
      !startsWithVariant(String(item.label), 'regional indicator'));

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox items={emojisView}>
        {item => <ListBoxItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</ListBoxItem>}
      </ListBox>
    </>
  );
}
